label: Dental groups
lead: Dental is chair-led, not doctor-led. The same chair runs 3-4 procedures a day across two practitioners. Treatment plans run 6 months, with EMIs that customers pay in chunks. Lucoze treats the chair as a first-class object — not a calendar block.
why: Each chair has its own queue. Utilisation visible at 4pm — you spot the dead Tuesday afternoon before it costs you a month.
Crown + RCT + bleach is one plan, 4 visits, 6 EMI instalments. Patient sees one bill, you see the open balance.
OPG, IOPA, CBCT — attached to the visit, viewable from the doctor’s chair. No flipping to the imaging laptop.
Cleaning at 6 months, post-op review at 7 days — automated, opt-out per patient.
